summary: This repair delivery audit checked the whole PRD at commit bbdc245, after the test audit's fixing chats. Since the last whole-PRD delivery audit (b51517d) the only runtime file changed is prompts/kiln-command-contracts.json, the help contract for kiln continue-with-phases, and only AC-BOT-01 runs through it. A fresh assessor and the main agent confirmed AC-BOT-01 is still implemented: the new help text matches the code, which accepts the instruction and settles a failed receipt with outcome proposal_changed or prerequisite_blocked. The other fourteen criteria keep their Implemented status. One round ran and found no gap, so nothing is left to build and the test audit continues.
